items.title: M1 Red/Repro tests before full implementation
items.context: Write failing/negative tests first for parent DONE with open child rows, allRowsClosed=false, partial_parent_done allowed-but-not-complete, child-story-needed blocking full-roadmap claims, stale child evidence, missing child story, invalid deferred-with-human-approval, summary overclaim, and the B-43de regression shape. Do this before runtime implementation changes.
items.userSees: The user sees a failing/negative parent-roadmap totality smoke listed and then turned green before runtime implementation proceeds.

happy.desc: A red/repro smoke exists before runtime model/evaluator implementation and covers the parent-roadmap overclaim failure class.

edge.desc: The smoke includes allRowsClosed=false, partial_parent_done, child-story-needed, stale evidence, missing child story, invalid deferred-with-human-approval, summary overclaim, and B-43de-shaped cases.

adversarial.desc: The story cannot mark M1 done if tests are added only after runtime implementation or if the smoke lacks an expected-red/negative-control proof.

verificationEvidence.command: git log --oneline --reverse cf25e3385..bd7700150 && git show --name-only --format=%s eec0fe75e
verificationEvidence.note: Shows the red/repro smoke commit eec0fe75e landed before runtime commit bd7700150 and only added parent-roadmap-totality-smoke.ts.
Full smoke covers allRowsClosed=false, partial_parent_done, child-story-needed, stale, blocked, invalid deferral, summary overclaim, and B-43de-shaped migration paths.
Negative controls prove caller-provided full rollup overrides are ignored and full-roadmap wording is blocked while child rows are open.

items.title: M2 State model and vocabulary
items.context: Implement canonical ParentRoadmapLedger row statuses, claim types, summary classes, strict validation, and round-trip persistence shape without breaking existing ProofStory records.
items.userSees: The user sees strict parent roadmap statuses and claim types accepted or rejected predictably by the smoke tests.

happy.desc: ParentRoadmapLedger, row statuses, summary classes, and claim types are exported and valid ledgers round-trip through validation.

edge.desc: Unknown statuses, invalid deferrals, and missing required closure evidence are rejected or classified invalid rather than silently closed.

adversarial.desc: A child-story-needed row remains valid data but never contributes to full roadmap closure.

verificationEvidence.note: State-model case verifies exported schema versions, row statuses, summary classes, claim types, and full ledger closure.
Unknown status is classified invalid_parent_rollup with invalidRows instead of being silently closed.
Child-story-needed rows remain valid data and still force no-full-roadmap-claim.

items.title: M3 Parent rollup evaluator
items.context: Implement a deterministic side-effect-free evaluator that computes ParentRollupResult, allRowsClosed, row-level reasons, stale/invalid/open classifications, and next actions.
items.userSees: The user sees parent roadmap rollup output that says full, partial, blocked, or invalid with row-level next actions.

happy.desc: Evaluator returns allRowsClosed=true and full-roadmap-claim only when every row has valid closure evidence.

edge.desc: Open, stale, blocked, missing, and invalid rows produce allRowsClosed=false with row-level reasons and next actions.

adversarial.desc: No caller-provided allRowsClosed or claimType override can force a full roadmap claim against row facts.

verificationEvidence.note: Evaluator returns allRowsClosed=true and full-roadmap-claim only for full fresh row evidence.
Open, stale, blocked, missing, and invalid rows produce allRowsClosed=false with row-level reasons and next actions.
Caller-provided parentLedgerRollup allRowsClosed=true and full-roadmap-claim are ignored; row facts recompute the rollup.

items.title: M4 Claim consumer and summary guard
items.context: Make summary/DONE-style claim wording consume ParentRollupResult so partial_parent_done cannot be described as full roadmap completion and full-roadmap wording requires allRowsClosed true.
items.userSees: The user sees summary text classified as partial parent done unless the rollup allows a full roadmap completion claim.

happy.desc: Claim consumer allows full-roadmap wording only when ParentRollupResult claimType is full-roadmap-claim.

edge.desc: partial_parent_done summary wording is allowed and lists open child rows / next actions.

adversarial.desc: Summary text equivalent to roadmap complete is blocked when the rollup requires no-full-roadmap-claim.

verificationEvidence.note: Claim consumer allows full-roadmap wording only when rollup claimType is full-roadmap-claim.
Honest parent governance complete; roadmap not complete wording is allowed for partial_parent_done with open rows.

verificationEvidence.command: node packages/main/dist/cli.js parent_roadmap_status {"case":"partial","summaryText":"Full roadmap complete; all M4-M12 rows are done.","mode":"enforce"}
verificationEvidence.note: CLI output reports Claim wording allowed: no for explicit full-roadmap overclaim while rows M4 and M5 remain open.

items.title: M5 B-5082 ProofStory binding
items.context: Bind parent-roadmap totality to originalIntentSnapshot, milestoneLedger, slicePlan, parent rollup, intentCollision, redEvidence, proofstoryContract, and done_intent_equivalence_check without weakening existing B-5082 gates.
items.userSees: The user sees ProofStory diagnostics show parent-totality is bound to the original intent and does not shrink open rows away.

happy.desc: Parent totality consumes originalIntentSnapshot, milestoneLedger, slicePlan, parent rollup, intentCollision, redEvidence, proofstoryContract, and done_intent_equivalence_check.

edge.desc: Existing B-5082 local-intent ProofStory gates still pass and old records remain readable.

adversarial.desc: A parent or child story cannot hide child-story-needed rows behind a narrower local acceptance claim.

verificationEvidence.note: Parent-roadmap binding consumes original intent snapshot, proofstory contract binding, row rollup, and summary wording to detect overclaim.
Existing B-5082 ProofStory local-intent gates still pass after adding the parent-roadmap totality module and commands.
Process-fact contract verifies parent-roadmap commands and runtime claim-consumer fact are registered, so child-story-needed rows cannot be hidden behind narrower prose claims.

items.title: M6 CLI and lifecycle integration
items.context: Expose parent roadmap totality through CLI and lifecycle/status surfaces in shadow/warn/enforce-compatible form. Operators need one command to see partial/full/blocked/invalid state and next actions.
items.userSees: The user runs a CLI status command and sees parent roadmap totality state plus next actions.

happy.desc: CLI exposes parent roadmap totality status for full, partial, blocked, and invalid ledgers.

edge.desc: Lifecycle/status projection lists child-story-needed rows and works in warn/shadow/enforce-compatible modes.

adversarial.desc: Unrelated single-story work is not blocked or classified as a parent roadmap by accident.

verificationEvidence.note: CLI smoke verifies parent_roadmap_status and parent_roadmap_evaluate expose full, partial, and migration states from provided ledgers or explicit cases.
CLI text lists migration_needed, no-full-roadmap-claim, open child rows M4-M12, and next actions.
CLI case includes B-unrelated negative control; unknown storyId fails with no parent roadmap ledger instead of being auto-classified.

items.title: M7 Migration rollout and repair
items.context: Add migration diagnostics or repair/runbook behavior for existing parent roadmap candidates such as B-43de without force-classifying historical stories as complete. Preserve evidence and rollout state.
items.userSees: The user sees historical parent roadmap candidates reported as migration-needed or partial, never silently complete.

happy.desc: Migration diagnostics classify B-43de-shaped historical ledgers as partial or migration-needed with open rows listed.

edge.desc: Legacy records without parent roadmap data remain readable and are not force-classified full complete.

adversarial.desc: Invalid deferred-with-human-approval without human evidence cannot close a row during migration or repair.

verificationEvidence.note: Migration smoke classifies B-43de-shaped historical ledger as migration_needed with open M5-M12 rows and no-full-roadmap-claim.
Legacy/migration status remains readable and prints open rows plus repair action rather than force-classifying full completion.
Invalid deferred-with-human-approval without complete human evidence is invalid_parent_rollup and cannot close a row.

items.title: M8 Cross-track certification
items.context: Add certification matrix proving full, partial, blocked, invalid, stale, migration, and summary paths; certify no overclaim when child rows are open and document remaining limits.
items.userSees: The user sees a certification matrix showing full, partial, blocked, invalid, stale, migration, and summary paths all covered.

happy.desc: Certification matrix includes full, partial, blocked, invalid, stale, migration, and summary paths with passing evidence.

edge.desc: Certification records final claim boundary and remaining limits without overclaiming full M4-M12 roadmap work.

adversarial.desc: Negative controls prove full-roadmap wording is impossible when child rows are open, stale, blocked, missing, or invalid.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/parent-roadmap-totality-smoke.js && node packages/main/dist/tasks/proofstory-intent-hardening-smoke.js && node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs
verificationEvidence.note: Certification commands pass on current HEAD and cover full, partial, blocked, invalid, stale, migration, summary, ProofStory, and process-fact paths.
Final claim boundary is explicit: B-43de-shaped migration remains no-full-roadmap-claim with open rows M4-M12 and repair guidance.
Negative controls prove full-roadmap wording is impossible when child rows are open, stale, blocked, missing, invalid, or an unrelated storyId has no parent ledger.
